source_contract.never_arrived: connection/refusal/4xx paths return TASK_TOOL_UNREACHABLE and issue exactly one request
source_contract.may_have_arrived: read timeout, remote disconnect, 5xx, unreadable/empty success responses return TASK_TOOL_UNCERTAIN
source_contract.retry_policy: the task is not automatically dispatched a second time; user-facing copy says outcome is uncertain and advises querying instead of redispatching
source_contract.privacy_logging: task text is not included in the INFO outcome log

decision: Reuse N.E.K.O native task receipt/uncertainty semantics. Do not revive the retired XiaoYu outbox/effect runtime.
